title: Read a member's current savings balance
description: Looks up a member by member number in Meridian and returns the current balance of their Savings account along with the member's name.
goal: Look up member {member_id} and read the current balance of their Savings account and their full name.

member_id.description: Member number as printed on the member card

savings_balance.description: Current balance of the member's Savings account

member_name.description: The member's full name as shown on the profile
